How the estimates work

Priority = 2 × impact + urgency + frequency band. The band is 1 for 1–4 occurrences, 2 for 5–14, and 3 for 15 or more. A score of 10 or more is high priority; 7–9 is medium.

Repeatable tasks taking at least 60 minutes a week are automation candidates. The overview assumes 50% savings. Each issue has its own adjustable scenario: weekly savings = baseline time × expected reduction; payback = implementation time ÷ weekly savings.

Measured savings compare the original weekly workload with the weekly time recorded after a change. Negative results mean the work took longer. Estimates and recorded results are kept separate. All records stay in this browser.

Built as a workflow improvement prototype. Use fictional data. No AI service or external database.
